name: Perihelion
description:
Crawlers who hold a comet's path in their heads and their muscles, and take it when they need to be elsewhere. The point of an orbit where a comet burns brightest is the point where it strikes.

Comet Charge carries you across a room faster than anything can answer: you can't lose health until your next turn, and everything around your landing flies back. What hits a wall takes more damage, is stunned and can't use its specials for a turn after it recovers. Split Nucleus sheds fragments of you that wear your gear and use your skills at reduced strength. Damage scales with [STR] and [PSI].

Requires the immortal fix: PlayerImmortalTag under [Fixes] in the Breachwork Loader config, on by default.

effects.name: Incandescent
effects.description: You are the comet now, and nothing can take health from you until your next turn.

effects.name: Calved
effects.description: A fragment split from a crawler's nucleus. It holds that crawler's gear and skills at reduced strength, and it won't hold together for long.

newAbility.name: Comet Charge
newAbility.description: You leave the deck as a comet and arrive before anything can answer. Whatever stands around your landing is thrown back, and a wall is a very bad thing to be thrown into.
newAbility.rules:
You streak to the spot you pick, or land beside the enemy you pick. You can't lose health until your next turn.
Everything within 2.1 of your landing takes Crushing damage and is thrown back 2 tiles, most bosses included.
What hits a wall or another body takes more damage, is stunned for 2 turns, and its special attacks stay down for 1 turn after it recovers.
Landing within 2.6 of your Ephemeris mark brings its comet down at once.
Scales with Strength + Psi Power.

perk.name: Burning Tail
perk.description: The debris behind you is still on fire when it lands.

newAbility.name: Coma Strike
newAbility.description: A blow with the comet's glowing shell wrapped around your arm. The shell burns what it touches.

perk.name: Bow Shock
perk.description: The shell hits a moment before your fist does. Enemies are pushed back a tile, and a wall behind them stuns them for a turn.

newAbility.name: Split Nucleus
newAbility.description: Comets calve under strain, and so do you. Two fragments of you break away for a few turns, in your gear and at your strength as it stands now. They fight with your weapon and your skills, for reduced damage and weaker status effects: 40% of your damage, and stuns, blinds and silences land 40% as often. Each has 30% of your health.

perk.name: Fast Fracture
perk.description: You have learned where you crack, and it takes no time at all.

newAbility.name: Ephemeris
newAbility.description: An ephemeris says where a comet will be, and when. You work one out for a spot on this deck, and what you worked out is already on its way down.
newAbility.rules:
Mark an enemy's tile or a spot within 7. In 2 turns a comet falls on the mark, and stepping on or off it changes nothing.
Everything within 2.6 of the mark takes Crushing and Fire damage and is thrown outward 2 tiles.
What hits a wall or another body takes more damage, is stunned for 2 turns, and its special attacks stay down for 1 turn after it recovers.
Landing Comet Charge or Extinction Arc within 2.6 of the mark brings the comet down at once.
One mark at a time. Scales with Strength + Psi Power.

perk.name: Tight Orbit
perk.description: The comet's weight arrives ahead of it, and what stands near the mark is drawn in tight.

newAbility.name: Tidal Pull
newAbility.description: A passing comet's weight, pressed on one spot of the deck. Everything nearby is dragged toward it and left off balance, packed close for your landing.

perk.name: Roche Limit
perk.description: Past this line a body stops holding itself together, and every gap in its guard shows.

newAbility.name: Outgassing
newAbility.description: Heat a comet and it vents. When something hurts you, a jet of burning gas sometimes throws it back a tile. If that puts it into a wall or another body, it is stunned for a turn.

newAbility.name: Rejoin Fragment
newAbility.description: Call a fragment back and fall to it. You land where it stood and take it back into you, healing some of what you've lost. The crash throws everything near it back a tile, and a wall stuns.

perk.name: Clean Return
perk.description: The fragment comes back with nearly everything it took.

newAbility.name: Short Period
newAbility.description: Your orbit tightens with every impact that ends something. When you or one of your allies makes a kill, all your other skills come back a turn sooner.

newAbility.name: Extinction Arc
newAbility.description: The comet that doesn't come back around. You go high and come down across the whole room, and the deck rings for a long while afterward.
newAbility.rules:
You streak to the spot you pick, or land beside the enemy you pick. You can't lose health until your next turn.
Everything within 3.2 of your landing takes heavy Crushing and Fire damage, starts Burning and is thrown back 3 tiles.
What hits a wall or another body takes more damage, is stunned for 2 turns, and its special attacks stay down for 2 turns after it recovers.
Landing within 2.6 of your Ephemeris mark brings its comet down at once.
Scales with Strength + Psi Power.

perk.name: Crater Rim
perk.description: The crater goes on burning, and it stands between them and you.
